entries.declaration_header:
theorem wickSpan_closure (u : CoefficientSpace) :
    (wickSpan u).topologicalClosure=singleGenerated u

theorem conditional_wick_projection {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace) (u : CoefficientSpace) (n : ℕ) :
    conditionalProjection h (wick u n)=(wick (sourceProjection h u) n : GaussianL2)

theorem conditional_firstChaos_projection {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace) (u : CoefficientSpace) :
    conditionalProjection h (firstChaosEmbedding u)=firstChaosEmbedding (sourceProjection h u)

theorem conditional_wick_energy {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace) (u : CoefficientSpace) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖conditionalProjection h (wick u n)‖^2=(n.factorial : ℝ)*(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^n

theorem terminal_expansion_hasSum (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1)
    (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u) :
    HasSum (fun n => coefficient u f n • (wick u n : GaussianL2)) f

theorem terminal_prediction_expansion {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u) :
    HasSum (fun n => coefficient u f n • (wick (sourceProjection h u) n : GaussianL2))
      (conditionalProjection h f)

theorem terminal_prediction_energy_hasSum {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u) :
    HasSum (fun n => (coefficient u f n)^2*(n.factorial : ℝ)*(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^n)
      (‖conditionalProjection h f‖^2)

theorem terminal_energy_hasSum (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1)
    (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u) :
    HasSum (fun n => (coefficient u f n)^2*(n.factorial : ℝ)) (‖f‖^2)

theorem terminal_prediction_rank_upper {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u)
    (m : ℕ) (hrank : ∀ n, n<m → coefficient u f n=0) :
    ‖conditionalProjection h f‖^2 ≤ (‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^m*‖f‖^2

theorem terminal_prediction_rank_lower {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u) (m : ℕ) :
    (coefficient u f m)^2*(m.factorial : ℝ)*(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^m ≤
      ‖conditionalProjection h f‖^2

theorem leading_rank_remainder {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u)
    (m : ℕ) (hrank : ∀ n, n<m → coefficient u f n=0) :
    0≤‖conditionalProjection h f‖^2-(coefficient u f m)^2*(m.factorial : ℝ)*(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^m ∧
    ‖conditionalProjection h f‖^2-(coefficient u f m)^2*(m.factorial : ℝ)*(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^m
      ≤(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^(m+1)*‖f‖^2

theorem normalized_rank_remainder {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u)
    (m : ℕ) (hrank : ∀ n, n<m → coefficient u f n=0)
    (hv : 0<‖sourceProjection h u‖^2) :
    0≤‖conditionalProjection h f‖^2/(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^m-
      (coefficient u f m)^2*(m.factorial : ℝ) ∧
    ‖conditionalProjection h f‖^2/(‖sourceProjection h u‖^2)^m-
      (coefficient u f m)^2*(m.factorial : ℝ)≤‖sourceProjection h u‖^2*‖f‖^2

theorem leading_rank_limit {X I : Type*} (l : Filter X) (h : X → I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u)
    (m : ℕ) (hrank : ∀ n, n<m → coefficient u f n=0)
    (hv0 : Tendsto (fun x => ‖sourceProjection (h x) u‖^2) l (𝓝 0))
    (hvpos : ∀ᶠ x in l, 0<‖sourceProjection (h x) u‖^2) :
    Tendsto (fun x => ‖conditionalProjection (h x) f‖^2/(‖sourceProjection (h x) u‖^2)^m)
      l (𝓝 ((coefficient u f m)^2*(m.factorial : ℝ)))

theorem augmented_past_eq (t : ℝ≥0) :
    augment (naturalPast H hH0 hH1 t) gaussianProduct =
      augment (MeasurableSpace.comap (firstChaosFamily
        (FractionalPredictionObstruction.pastDirections H hH0 hH1 t)) inferInstance)
        gaussianProduct

theorem conditionalProjection_actual_past (t : ℝ≥0) (F : GaussianL2) :
    conditionalProjection (FractionalPredictionObstruction.pastDirections H hH0 hH1 t) F
      =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] gaussianProduct[F | naturalPast H hH0 hH1 t]

theorem terminal_forecast_actual_past (t : ℝ≥0) :
    FractionalPredictionObstruction.forecast H hH0 hH1 t =ᵐ[gaussianProduct]
      gaussianProduct[process H hH0 hH1 1 | naturalPast H hH0 hH1 t]

theorem terminal_covariance_linear_lower (H : ℝ) (hH0 : 0<H) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t≤1) :
    (t : ℝ)/2 ≤ FractionalSpectralGeometry.covariance H 1 t

theorem linear_forecast_dual_lower (H : ℝ) (hH0 : 0<H) (hH1 : H<1)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (ht0 : 0<t) (ht1 : t≤1) :
    (t : ℝ)^(predictionPower H)/4 ≤ ‖FractionalPredictionObstruction.forecast H hH0 hH1 t‖^2

theorem terminal_forecast_dual_lower (H : ℝ) (hH0 : 0<H) (hH1 : H<1)
    (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (ht0 : 0<t) (ht1 : t≤1) (m : ℕ) :
    ((coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f m)^2*(m.factorial : ℝ)/(4 : ℝ)^m)*
      (t : ℝ)^(predictionPower H*(m : ℝ)) ≤ ‖forecast H hH0 hH1 f t‖^2

theorem no_higher_dual_prediction_increment_bound (H : ℝ) (hH0 : 0<H) (hH1 : H<1)
    (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1))
    (hc : coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f 0=0)
    (m : ℕ) (hcm : coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f m≠0)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : predictionPower H*(m : ℝ)<α) (C δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    ∃ t : ℝ≥0, 0<t ∧ (t : ℝ)<δ ∧ t≤1 ∧
      C*(t : ℝ)^α < ‖forecast H hH0 hH1 f t-forecast H hH0 hH1 f 0‖^2

theorem exists_positive_terminal_rank (H : ℝ) (hH0 : 0<H) (hH1 : H<1)
    (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1))
    (hc : coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f 0=0) (hf0 : f≠0) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0<m ∧ coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f m≠0 ∧
      ∀ n<m, coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f n=0
def potentialOperator : GaussianL2 →L[ℝ] GaussianL2

theorem potential_hasSum (f : GaussianL2) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • projection n f) (potentialOperator f)

theorem potential_positive (f : GaussianL2) :
    inner ℝ (potentialOperator f) f=‖recovery f‖^2

theorem potential_preserves_generated {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    {f : GaussianL2} (hf : f∈generated h) : potentialOperator f∈generated h

theorem single_observation_potential_compact (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) :
    IsCompactOperator (potentialOperator.comp (conditionalProjection (fun _ : Unit => u)))

theorem potential_inner (f g : GaussianL2) :
    inner ℝ (potentialOperator f) g=inner ℝ f (potentialOperator g)

theorem potential_sector (n : ℕ) (f : sector n) :
    potentialOperator f=(n : ℝ)⁻¹ • (f : GaussianL2)

theorem potential_coefficient (u : CoefficientSpace) (f : GaussianL2) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient u (potentialOperator f) n=(n : ℝ)⁻¹*coefficient u f n

theorem positive_coefficient_iff (u : CoefficientSpace) (f : GaussianL2) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) :
    coefficient u (potentialOperator f) n≠0 ↔ coefficient u f n≠0

theorem potential_prediction_energy {I : Type*} (h : I → CoefficientSpace)
    (u : CoefficientSpace) (hu : ‖u‖^2=1) (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated u) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ)⁻¹*coefficient u f n)^2*(n.factorial : ℝ)*
      (‖GaussianWickConditionalProjection.sourceProjection h u‖^2)^n)
      (‖conditionalProjection h (potentialOperator f)‖^2)

theorem fractional_potential_lower (H : ℝ) (hH0 : 0<H) (hH1 : H<1)
    (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (ht0 : 0<t) (ht1 : t≤1) (m : ℕ) :
    (((m : ℝ)⁻¹*coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f m)^2*
      (m.factorial : ℝ)/(4 : ℝ)^m)*(t : ℝ)^(predictionPower H*(m : ℝ)) ≤
      ‖forecast H hH0 hH1 (potentialOperator f) t‖^2

theorem fractional_potential_no_higher_bound (H : ℝ) (hH0 : 0<H) (hH1 : H<1)
    (f : GaussianL2) (hf : f∈singleGenerated (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1))
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) (hcm : coefficient (terminalDirection H hH0 hH1) f m≠0)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : predictionPower H*(m : ℝ)<α) (C δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    ∃ t : ℝ≥0, 0<t ∧ (t : ℝ)<δ ∧ t≤1 ∧
      C*(t : ℝ)^α < ‖forecast H hH0 hH1 (potentialOperator f) t-
        forecast H hH0 hH1 (potentialOperator f) 0‖^2

theorem source_covariances :
    inner ℝ (direction 4) (direction 2)=1 ∧
    inner ℝ (direction 4) (direction 1)=(3-Real.sqrt 3)/2 ∧
    inner ℝ (direction 2) (direction 1)=Real.sqrt 2/2 ∧
    ‖direction 2‖^2=Real.sqrt 2

theorem current_forecast_earlier_pairing :
    inner ℝ currentForecast (firstChaosEmbedding (direction 1))=1/2

theorem full_forecast_earlier_pairing :
    inner ℝ fullForecast (firstChaosEmbedding (direction 1))=(3-Real.sqrt 3)/2
theorem full_past_not_current : fullForecast≠currentForecast
theorem strict_prediction_energy_gain : ‖currentForecast‖^2<‖fullForecast‖^2

paper_sections.1-2: full L2 terminal Hermite expansion and conditional Wick projection; rank energy and remainder
paper_sections.3: actual continuous fractional past and dual-regime lower obstruction
paper_sections.4: actual inverse-number potential, single-observation compactness, coefficient preservation

human_reorganization: Hermite completeness is proved through an entire Gaussian Laplace transform and finite-measure Fourier uniqueness; the formal proof uses its already established Gaussian generated polynomial density and chaos decomposition.

The conditional Wick formula is proved through Gaussian residual independence and the exponential generating function; the formal proof uses coefficient pairing recursions and generated-space density.
Actual continuous-past identification is only at the L2/mod-null level. Raw sigma-algebras are not equated and no common exceptional set for uncountably many coordinates is assumed.

Single-observation compactness is reconstructed by diagonal Hermite truncation. Full-source potential noncompactness is a classical consequence of exact identity on infinite first chaos, not an additional named formal theorem.

The fractional exponent is only used in an explicit lower bound and no-higher-power obstruction. Primary literature already supplies sharper covariance asymptotics; no new exponent or optimal lower constant is asserted.
